operator_observation: Dave reported that MIM/TOD do not appear to have accomplished much with the projects.

audit_result.summary: Project movement visible in Studio was mostly MIM Project Reconciler evidence ingestion, not fresh MIM/TOD execution.

lesson: Reconciled prior evidence is useful for continuity, but it is not the same as MIM/TOD accomplishing new work. Studio must distinguish reconciled-only movement from MIM/TOD-originated execution.
fix: Add event-source counters to Studio project rows.
Classify movement as MIM/TOD moving, Codex moved, reconciled only, frozen, seed only, blocked, or waiting Dave.
Show MIM/TOD, Codex, and Reconciled counts in the Project Inbox Movement column.
required_next_step: Create the project execution dispatcher so MIM assigns one eligible project to TOD/MIM and records real project events when work starts, stalls, validates, or escalates.
